decision: Preserve the TQP-57 CPU Terrain Standard 1.0 release as history and require a qualified six-step CPU production closure before TQP-58, using the corrected authority, terrain implementation, broad terrain, temporal continuity, prefetch readiness, bounded performance, and self-contained Godot 4.7 release evidence.
ordered_subgates: TQP-R03 global coarse coverage and local refinement
TQP-R04 cache, prefetch, and targeted collision readiness
evidence_used: digest-pinned broad acceptance, temporal continuity, prefetch readiness, closure, and clean-install bundle reports
qualified_scope: 2048x256x2048-cell bounded Windows terrain with 512 global coarse roots and observed LOD0 through LOD3 local refinement
construction material ownership without repainting existing solid samples
temporal streaming continuity with zero retained overlap or topology failures
visual prefetch separated from targeted collision demand and zero storage or mesh work at the prefetched arrival
2700-frame three-logical-CPU release-runtime baseline with retained process telemetry
self-contained world-transvoxel-terrain 1.1.0-rc1 Godot 4.7 bundle with a clean extracted-project smoke pass
TQP-58 eligibility for a measured architecture decision
unqualified_scope: public Godot Asset Library submission, moderation, or acceptance
sustained 60 FPS at 16 GPU-board watts, CPU-package watts, or whole-system watts
performance on untested hardware or outside the retained Windows reference envelope
any GPU architecture selection, implementation, correctness equivalence, performance benefit, or release
standards_changed: CPU production closure standard and retained evidence version 1
TQP-58 now requires both qualified CPU preconditions without changing milestone numbering
review: All six correction subgates pass under affinity [0, 1, 2] and -j3 build limits. Current evidence separates scenario p99 ceiling 70.161 ms from worst single frame 98.044 ms, retains zero frames over 100 ms, and leaves unavailable power measurements explicitly unqualified.
downstream_impact: TQP-58 may now compare GPU architecture options against the corrected CPU release candidate. CPU world-transvoxel remains the correctness authority, and no GPU promotion or public Asset Library acceptance is implied.
